To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.

There is a horizontal dotted segment from zero, three to two three that is labeled two. There is a vertical dotted segment from two, three to two, two that is labeled negative one.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{1}{2}$.
